page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 8 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB per core, alongside a bundled 479 GB local SSD storage volume. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average performance across most standard operations. The server achieves middle-tier results in Passmark CPU and memory tests, as well as in Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput. However, compute-intensive workloads reveal some limitations; single-core stress-ng performance, single-threaded gzip compression, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression fall into the bottom 25% of tested systems. LLM inference benchmarks show average speeds for small 135M models but drop to poor performance when handling medium 7B models.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated local SSD storage, the ecs.i3g.2xlarge offers a resource-dense profile for general-purpose workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance, though the moderate 2.5 GHz clock speed and weak single-core metrics suggest a tradeoff where high-frequency compute is deprioritized. This server is best suited for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose applications that benefit from local SSD caching without requiring heavy parallel processing or large-scale LLM execution.
